value.rationale: The source work-optimal transport is experimentally motivated, while the negative fourth work-cumulant theorem differentiates non-Gaussian telegraph activity from covariance-matched Gaussian propulsion despite identical mean and variance. The sharp leading normalized coefficient is independent of stiffness and displacement, and a physically realizable two-step cyclic protocol reverses the sign. This identifies a measurable control-sensitive non-Gaussian effect, not a cosmetic invariant or slight routine numerical sharpening.
